story.title: The Shadow Ledger
story.logline: A woman discovers her smartwatch does not track her steps, but rather the exact moments she loses her moral courage.
story.twist: The steps do not measure distance walked, but the feet walked backward away from help.
story.ending: When will you finally take a step forward?

scenes.narration: My watch vibrates at midnight, flashing a number that makes my stomach completely drop to the floor.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, wearing an oversized grey hoodie, staring at a glowing smartwatch in a dark bedroom.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the glowing watch screen, rack focus to Maya's terrified eyes.

scenes.narment: Four thousand steps. But I haven't left my apartment all day long. Not even for coffee.
scenes.narration: Four thousand steps. But I haven't left my apartment all day long. Not even for coffee.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, oversized grey hoodie, looking around her quiet, empty bedroom in confusion.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, panning slowly across the empty floor to her bare feet.

scenes.narration: Then I remember the subway platform this morning. The man who tripped, dropping his heavy briefcase.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, grey hoodie, standing frozen in a crowded subway station, watching a fallen man.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot looking down at the struggling man.

scenes.narration: Everyone walked right past him. And so did I. My feet kept moving without missing a beat.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, grey hoodie, walking briskly past the fallen man while commuters ignore him.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot moving backward in front of Maya, keeping her centered.

scenes.narration: I look down at the screen again. The label above the number changes right before my eyes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, grey hoodie, staring down at her wrist under the harsh apartment lamp.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the watch display shifting text.

scenes.narration: It doesn't track distance. It tracks retreat. Every step away from someone who needed help.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, grey hoodie, eyes wide with realization as she reads the tiny glowing words.
scenes.camera: Close-up on Maya's face reflecting the blue screen light.

scenes.narration: My phone lights up with a local news alert. A robbery happened at that exact subway stop.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, grey hoodie, looking at her phone notification flashing on the nightstand.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, push in slowly on Maya's trembling hands.

scenes.narration: If I had stopped, I could have stopped it. Four thousand steps of pure cowardice.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, grey hoodie, backing away from the bed in absolute horror and shame.
scenes.camera: Wide shot framing Maya trapped between the bed and the dark wall.

scenes.narration: The watch vibrates again. A brand new number appears, ticking upward as I stand here shaking.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, grey hoodie, lifting her wrist as the numbers rapidly increase on the screen.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the digits spinning upward.

scenes.narration: Another crisis happening right now across town. When will you finally take a step forward?
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 25, short dark bob, grey hoodie, staring directly into the camera lens with sudden, grim resolve.

caption.hook: Your watch is counting your deepest regrets.
caption.title: The Shadow Ledger
caption.caption:
It wasn't tracking her steps. It was measuring every single time she looked away when someone needed her.

How heavy is your invisible score?
